g.text: A one-task DAG submitted through the console, from POST /api/executions to SUCCEEDED. Solid arrows are calls, dashed are returns.
2. app.authenticate: session JWT or bot token → authUser {teamNames, isAdmin}
3. withProductIdentities · extractTasksAuthInfo · authorizeTasksOrReply: a member of each task's team?
team not retired? runs as its product's identity (identityRefusal)? each secretRef its team's? (isSecretRegistered)
4. replyIfImagesBlocked: imageRefusal (image policy) · missingImages (registry.ts) → 422 if blocked
8. get_execution_by_idempotency_key: seen before? return it (200, no new rows)
9. validate_dag: duplicate ids, unknown dependencies, cycles, $fromTask references
_build_execution_graph: each task READY (no dependencies) or BLOCKED
10. INSERT executions, execution_tasks, task_dependencies · record_event EXECUTION_CREATED
recover_expired_leases; SELECT READY … FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED;
17. _create_config_map ek-…: request.json · _create_job ek-…: args=[action], serviceAccount, secret volumes
18. admission: dispatch-policy · image-policy · identity-policy · image signature (GKE)
refused → DispatchRejectedError → task FAILED, not retried
22. does the work; writes /platform/output/result.json (read back as the termination message)
23. next tick: _load_running_tasks_owned_by → _poll_task: execution cancelled? past timeout_seconds?
loop [while the Job runs: one poll per tick]
29. failed: _handle_task_failure → should_retry? READY again (TASK_FAILED; claimed next tick)
otherwise FAILED → _fail_execution (execution FAILED; its READY/BLOCKED tasks CANCELLED)
32. state, tasks [state, attempts, outputs, failure, dependsOn]
33. the execution, as the UI shows it
